reverie.title: REVERIE — dawn light in a paddock near home
narr: you stand where the first light reaches, and she points
at how each beam is teaching the air to be visible.
she says: light doesn't illuminate. it composes.
you watch the paddock learn what it looks like.
her hand moves through a shaft of gold, and she becomes
part of what the morning is writing.
